All 18 playbook rules have been reviewed and submitted. Summary of our position on this IBM e-business Hosting Agreement:

**Deviations requiring redlines (6)**
- **LOL-CAP** (critical): caps are mutual and 12-month-fee based, but there are no carve-outs for confidentiality/data protection, gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud, and § 9.1(c)(2) excludes IBM liability for loss of our records or data outright.
- **WARRANTY**: care-and-skill warranty only; Materials are "AS IS" with no conformance period and no remedy — added a 90-day conformance warranty with re-performance/refund, carved out of the disclaimers.
- **LICENSE** (high): Base Components licence is revocable at will and excludes our Affiliates and contractors.
- **LD** (high): convenience exit conditioned on uncapped early termination charges in Attachment A — capped at 3 months' charges.
- **RENEWAL**: 90-day non-renewal window and renewal for a term equal to the prior term (potential auto multi-year) — fixed at 12 months / 30 days.
- **INSURANCE** and **TRANSITION** (missing): no coverage obligation at all, and no data return, deletion or migration assistance on exit — both inserted.

**Compliant (10)**: INDEMN (IP indemnity present and uncapped, at/above fallback), NONCOMPETE, EXCLUSIVITY, MFN, NOSOLICIT, T4C (one month's notice for us; no IBM convenience right), GOVLAW (New York law, no arbitration), ASSIGN (M&A carve-out, reasonable-consent standard, no change-of-control trigger), IP (we own Type I Materials; perpetual paid-up licence to Type II), AUDIT (no audit rights against us).

Two watch-items depend on documents not in front of us: the Attachment A early termination charges and any Order Form minimums.
